init_coconut_model: initialize a Coconut model wrapping a GPT2 or Llama3 causal language model with latent token IDs
forward_coconut: run a multi-pass forward pass through Coconut that replaces latent tokens with preceding hidden states
generate_coconut: generate text autoregressively using Coconut with latent token feedback and FSDP sync support
train_coconut: set the Coconut model and its wrapped base causal language model to training mode
eval_coconut: set the Coconut model and its wrapped base causal language model to evaluation mode
